features.title: Product intake and file classification
features.user_visible_behavior: Admin forwards a product batch and the bot separates previews from main files.

features.title: Admin metadata collection and confirmation
features.user_visible_behavior: Bot asks for product name, category, price, shows a review, and publishes only after confirmation.

features.title: Preview publication and purchase CTA
features.user_visible_behavior: Store channel shows grouped previews with product information and purchase button.

features.title: Product administration
features.user_visible_behavior: Admin can edit price/category/tags, remove or republish products with audit records.

features.title: Order and Zarinpal payment flow
features.user_visible_behavior: Customer receives a payment link and verified payment marks the order paid exactly once.

features.title: Crypto payment provider abstraction
features.user_visible_behavior: Customer can eventually choose a crypto provider without changing order/domain logic.

features.title: Paid multi-file delivery
features.user_visible_behavior: After verified payment, all main product files are delivered from Telegram references and delivery is tracked.

features.title: Production hardening and observability
features.user_visible_behavior: Operators can diagnose failures, retry safe operations, and inspect health/metrics/logs.

features.title: Future WooCommerce/webhook integration
features.user_visible_behavior: An external website can create/lookup products and initiate Telegram commerce without coupling to Telegram handlers.
features.notes: Phase 6+ extension; do not prematurely implement.
